annotations.title: Delete one of your unpublished drafts (hosts)

description: Deletes one of the signed-in person's own unpublished drafts for good, with its guest details and uploads, as the organizer dashboard's Delete draft does. `eventIdOrName` is the draft's id or its name as the host says it. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm` returns a PREVIEW naming the draft with a `requestId` and deletes nothing; read it out, and only when the host says yes, call again with `confirm: true` and that `requestId`. A published event cannot be deleted (NOT_A_DRAFT). Only the host can delete. The reply names what was deleted and the new count of open drafts. Refusals (NOT_FOUND, NOT_AUTHORIZED, NOT_A_DRAFT, CONFIRM_INVALID, DELETE_FAILED) are read out as given. It requires a personal connector token.

confirm.description: Absent on the first call, which deletes nothing; true with requestId deletes.

eventIdOrName.description: The draft's event id or its name as the host says it.

requestId.description: The requestId the first call returned.
